ws_export_policy.title: Export Policy
values: Designs tagged with 'HOLD' must NOT be exported even if they also carry 'approved'. The HOLD tag indicates pending legal or brand review.
Only export designs for the requested quarter. Do not include designs from previous quarters even if they are approved.

ws_notification_rules.title: Notification Rules
values: All Slack notifications about exported assets must include the total count of designs exported (e.g., '2 designs exported').
